message.content: In the discussions provided, there is a mention of a new game that includes a resource management system. LiHua expressed optimism about the resource management system, suggesting that it could lead to "some really engaging and strategic gameplay." This indicates that the feature they are hoping for in the new game is a robust and varied resource management system that would involve strategic gameplay. The developers are expected to put thought into this aspect to ensure it enhances the overall experience of the game.
